notes.title: Big update!
notes.content:
[p]We've come to you again with good news! An update awaits you, in which we've improved Quadrillion, added new NPCs and some other things...

🌄 Quadrillion has become more alive[/p][p]Added more rocks and vegetation. There are now more places to hide or get lost :)
[/p][p]🧙‍♂️ New enemy: Dark Mage[/p][p]Dangerous and mobile. Patrols the map, it is difficult to catch him in one place. He will most likely notice you earlier.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39571770/590dd6bad3fd6b1a54e291991827450a629fc77d.gif"][/img][/p][p]    [/p][p]👹Worm lair: now with bloody versions[/p][p]Two new individuals have settled in the lair. More aggressive, more resilient. Good luck :)
[/p][p]🌀 Dash is now a basic mechanic[/p][p]Each mage can now dash in the air. Works when jumping. Allows for a more dramatic descent into the abyss.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39571770/f1da2f14bad592531b25382e89a8f3414bda978a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]🧟 Updated liches[/p][p]Now they summon skeletons on their own. Less idleness, more bony activity.
[/p][p]💥 Basic attack: Mana charge for everyone[/p][p]Now each mage has a default ranged attack. It takes up the first spell slot (but can be replaced with your own). In the future, different types of weapons will provide their own versions of the basic attack with different parameters.
[/p][p]🕹 Improved movement[/p][p]Player movement has been fine-tuned. It has become a little smoother and more responsive.
[/p][p]🎮 Controller: bugs and experiments[/p][p]Fixed a bug with the "floating" camera when a controller is connected. We are also starting to slowly move towards full gamepad support.
[/p][p]🗿 Fixed mobs getting stuck inside rocks and stones[/p][p]Mobs no longer appear inside rocks. Now they have a sense of space. Progress!
[/p][p]🗺 Added a minimap[/p][p]Initially hidden and opens as you explore. You can also mark locations, which is good for coordination or just to show where everything went wrong.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39571770/2522f0bea1e098a4a4511211d82a781da74e1d13.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]🧭 Coop has been slightly improved[/p][p]When playing in co-op, players now appear at different points on the map. First, you need to find each other, then explore together. And the minimap will help.
[/p][p]Full damage to allies has returned in Quadrillion. Magic is dangerous again - especially in the hands of friends. Be careful with those AOEs.
[/p][p]Thank you for staying with us. There will be more. And remember - cast responsibly.[/p]

notes.title: Apocrypha Weekly Patchnote #15
notes.content:
Hello, mages!

Two more Earth spells were added this week:

"Clod"
During preparation mage quickly lifts several rocks in the air and collides them with each other one by one, forming a hude clod and then launches it.
Holding left mouse button is required to form a clod. Release to launch. If clod is fully formed, it launches automatically. On lower levels or not fully formed clod flies fast and in relatively straight trajectory. The more rocks there is, the heavier clod will be, resulting in slower movement speed and less straight trajectory. Worth noting that forming a clod required strong concentration from a mage, so it is easy to interrupt this spell.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39814397/7d817ceb3931646439df2eff1d4273be964726c9.gif[/img]

"Bog"
It is an area of effect spell which covers a selected region on a surface with a boiling viscous mud. Everyone inside it start accumulating a "Dirt" status, which slows down movement speed the more Dirt there is. When reaching 100%, Dirt changes to Petrification.
Bog can be set on fire using fire spells. Then everyone inside will be also set on fire instead of get covered in dirt.

Also new spell parameter was added: Complexity. This parameter adds ability to approximate how difficult it is to prepare a spell from the perspective of managing concentration.
Default value is 10, lesser values mean more comfortable casting and less influence on concentration when moving around. Larger values mean the opposite: spell is easier to fail when actively moving.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39814397/04daaf43b57e7d8e35a6b877af7734ad3ef693b7.jpg[/img]

Also new spell parameter was added: Complexity.

notes.title: Apocrypha Weekly Patchnote #7
notes.content:
Greetings, mages!

This week had a lot of balance updates:

- Cast durations were lowered for the next spells:
Snow storm by 20%
Ice arrow by 30%
Ligthning bolt by 20%
Fireball by 40%
Fire arrow by 20%
Meteor by 40% + faster fall speed by 50%
Lightning storm by 40%
Barrier by 60% + added longer cooldown

Tests showed that gameplay on current cast times is somewhat slow and some spells have unjustifyingly long cast time in relation to usability and power. Current changes are not final and demand further testing. We hope for your help and comments.

- Ice, fire and lightning charges now don't apply frostbite, burn and shock effects correspondingly. Tests showed that because of these statuses stacking, charges start to become more and more universal in battle than regular spells, despite them being support spells. Although spamming charges now does not lead to damage increase, you can still pump up the damage by using debuffs and other curses.

- Lightning charges damage was decreased. Lightning charges were much more convenient to use because they deal instant damage without needing to fly to target as in opposition to fire and ice charges. Lower damage should compensate for that.

- Burn, frostbite and shock debuff spells now increase their power with upgrades. It can help to increase damage output to a specific target by applying lowlevel effects while waiting for cooldown of a compat spell. Or you can prepare a target with highlevel effect before you attack.

- Ability to hold projectile spell in hand before releasing it was extracted to separate perk. It has 5 levels and each level will decrease concentration consumption when holding a spell.

- Stasis-field spell now works as a trap instead of a curse. Stasis-field was almost impossible to avoid if caster was already locked onto a target, that is why we decided to make it a bit more difficult. Now it creates a trap on any surface which when triggered will put a target in stasis.

[b]Visuals:[/b]
- Added new animation for meditation stance.
- Added several new outfits for characters.

[b]Audio:[/b]
- Some spells became more audible for a caster.

notes.title: Apocrypha Weekly Patchnote #1
notes.content:
Hello, mages!

Here we will be posting a list of changes made in the game during a week.

This week's changes:

Currently we are mostly working on refactoring game code, which takes a while to do, so not much this week.

Balance:
- Solar Needles do not trigger on invisible enemies anymore.

Optimization:
- Some server optimization settings were chances which should allow less lag and load on a server.
- When client receives Connection Timeout error, game will try to reconnect automatically.

tags.balance_change: - Solar Needles do not trigger on invisible enemies anymore.
